data.ask: which supplier is behind the products with the most damage complaints
data.cypher: MATCH (v0:Ticket)-[:TOUCHES]->(v1:Batch)-[:MADE_BY]->(v2:Supplier) WHERE v0.issue_type = "damaged" RETURN v2.id AS supplier_id, count(v0) AS complaint_count ORDER BY complaint_count DESC LIMIT 1
